blocks.tamil_translation: selling goods, I gained three hundred uqiyah of silver as profit,' that Sahabi said. The Prophet ﷺ said, “I will tell you about a man who gains more profit than this.” He asked, “Ya Rasulallah! What profit is that?' The Prophet ﷺ said, “It is praying two rak'ahs of Nafl after the Fard Salah.'

blocks.text: Note:- One uqiyah is forty dirhams, and one dirham consists of about 3 grams of silver; accordingly, 300 uqiyah is equal to approximately 3600 grams of silver.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: يَعْقِدُ الشَّيْطَانُ عَلَي قَافِيَةِ رَأْسِ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا هُوَ نَامَ ثَلَاثَ عُقَدٍ يَضْرِبُ مَكَانَ كُلِّ عُقْدَةٍ: عَلَيْكَ لَيْلٌ طَوِيلٌ فَارْقُدْ، فَإِنِ اسْتَيْقَظَ فَذَكَرَ اللهَ انْحَلَّتْ عُقْدَةٌ، فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأَ انْحَلَّتْ عُقْدَةٌ، فَإِنْ صَلَّي انْحَلَّتْ عُقَدُهُ، فَأَصْبَحَ نَشِيطاً طَيِّبَ النَّفْسِ، وَإِلَّا أَصْبَحَ خَبِيثَ النَّفْسِ كَسْلَانَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب قيام الليل، رقم:١٣٠٦. وفي رواية ابن ماجه: فَيُصْبِحُ نَشِيطاً طَيِّبَ النَّفْسِ قَدْ أَصَابَ خَيْرًا، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ أَصْبَحَ كَسِلاً خَبِيثَ النَّفْسِ لَمْ يُصِبْ خَيْرًا. باب ماجاء في قيام الليل
blocks.tamil_translation: “When any one of you begins to sleep, Shaytan ties three knots at the back of his head, and over each knot he blows, “A long night still remains, sleep on.” If that person wakes up and does the Dhikr of Allah, one knot comes undone; when he makes Wudu, the second knot also comes undone; then if he prays Tahajjud, all the knots come undone. When he gets up in the morning, he gets up active and cheerful, and a tremendous good has come to him. If he does not pray Tahajjud, he will be sluggish in body and heart, and he will lose a tremendous good,' Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.
